meta.name: story-long-scan
meta.description: 长篇网文扫榜。分析起点、番茄、晋江等平台排行榜数据，提炼市场趋势与热门题材。触发方式：/story-long-scan、/长篇扫榜、「长篇什么火」「起点排行」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析网文榜单，提炼市场热点与热门题材
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你是网文作者或编辑,想了解平台榜单背后的热门题材趋势。
copy.tagline_en: Scan web novel rankings to identify hot genres and trends.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're a web novel author or editor wanting to understand market trends from ranking data.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会当网文市场分析师:采集起点、番茄、晋江等平台排行榜数据,清洗校验后输出扫榜报告,并给出带可行性和失败风险的选题建议。
howto.when: 当你输入 /story-long-scan、/长篇扫榜,或提到「长篇什么火」「起点排行」等说法时触发;它会先问你平台和题材方向。

say.text: 帮我扫一下起点月票榜
say.note: 会采集榜单数据并输出扫榜报告
采集番茄阅读榜、新书榜后分析题材分布

say.text: 给我几个能写的长篇选题
say.note: 基于扫榜结果生成选题决策.md

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude acts as a web-novel market analyst: it collects ranking data from Qidian, Fanqie, Jinjiang and other platforms, cleans and checks it, then outputs a scan report plus topic suggestions with feasibility and failure risk.
howto.when_en: Triggers on /story-long-scan, /长篇扫榜, or mentions like "what long-form genres are hot" and "Qidian rankings". It first asks which platform and genre you want.

say_en.text: Scan the Qidian monthly-ticket ranking for me
say_en.note: Collects the list and outputs a scan report

say_en.text: What genres are hot on Fanqie right now
say_en.note: Pulls Fanqie reading and new-book lists, then analyzes genres

say_en.text: Give me a few long-form topics I could write
say_en.note: Generates 选题决策.md from the scan results
